flows.name: F02-01 Dropdown 定向回归：方案卡菜单-草稿确认菜单-点击推进-只读不写入

steps.text: 生成 A 机房昨日能耗日报，包含总耗电、设备耗电排名和昨日逐小时耗电趋势

steps.eval: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.plan-action-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled).map(s => Array.from(s.options).map(o => o.textContent.trim()).join(',')).join('|') === '请选择方案操作,确认方案,其他修改'

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.plan-action-select'); const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '确认方案'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(s => s.getAttribute('data-wp-history') !== '1').map(s => Array.from(s.options).map(o => o.textContent.trim()).join(',')).join('|') === '请选择,同意,修改,重新开始'

steps.screenshot: f02-01-02-草稿确认菜单存在且可点

steps.eval: (() => { const s = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(x => x.getAttribute('data-wp-history') !== '1' && !x.disabled).pop(); const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '同意'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const i = document.querySelector('dialog[open] input[name="draftName"]'); if (!i) return false; i.value = '第二批 F02 回归草稿'; return true; })()

steps.screenshot: f02-01-03-点同意后草稿落库并弹出存草稿对话框
